tips.text: Run the three daily Hexis Syndicate Alerts and pick up every medallion; they pay out past the daily cap.
Run the alerts solo; public squads rush to extraction and will not wait while you search.
Bring a max-range Xaku or Limbo with loot radar to break every crate; whatever still shows on the minimap is a medallion.
Fill the cap fast with an affinity farm: Elite Sanctuary Onslaught to round 8, a stealth-kill farm, or Steel Path Circuit.
Check your pledge before a long run; a Red Veil pledge drains Hexis and the run is wasted.
Rank up before you earn past the bar's cap; the extra standing is wasted.
Use the Orokin Eye or Golden Instinct to ping medallions; place the Eye where the most rooms are in range.
Use an Affinity Booster; it roughly doubles the passive standing.
Rank Hexis and Suda together; pledging Hexis also builds Suda at half rate.
Bank medallions; they never expire and ignore the cap, so turn them in whenever the bar has room.
Spend any Perrin Sequence and Red Veil standing before you pledge Hexis.
Expect about two and a half weeks of normal play, or about one week with the alert medallions.
Players' usual regret is pledging Red Veil first and digging out of negative Hexis standing.
